long_biography.plain_text:
Born and raised in Kansas City, Larry Van Tuyl graduated in business from the University of Kansas and studied in Germany. He entered his father Cecil's automotive company, then moved to Phoenix and founded Automotive Investment Group in 1982. Its partnership model gave local dealership managers minority stakes, aligning operating responsibility with ownership.

Larry and Cecil later merged their companies to form Van Tuyl Group. The business grew into the nation's largest privately held dealership network before Berkshire Hathaway acquired it in 2015. Van Tuyl served as chairman of the renamed Berkshire Hathaway Automotive, then returned to directing the family's investment platform and real-estate developer VanTrust.

Born and raised in Kansas City, Larry Van Tuyl graduated in business from the University of Kansas and studied in Germany. He entered his father Cecil's automotive company, then moved to Phoenix and founded Automotive Investment Group in 1982. Its partnership model gave local dealership managers minority stakes, aligning operating responsibility with ownership.

Larry and Cecil later merged their companies to form Van Tuyl Group. The business grew into the nation's largest privately held dealership network before Berkshire Hathaway acquired it in 2015. Van Tuyl served as chairman of the renamed Berkshire Hathaway Automotive, then returned to directing the family's investment platform and real-estate developer VanTrust.
